Join Our STEM Carnival!Are you ready to explore the future? Come to our STEM Carnival this Saturday at the City Centre!
It will be a fun day for everyone interested in Science, Technology, Engineering and Maths. You can build robots, try cool chemistry experiments and use VR headsets. It’s a great way to learn and play at the same time!
Venue: Main Square, Kuala Lumpur
Date/Time: 17 July 2026 / 10 a.m. – 4 p.m.
Entrance: Free!
